visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a light blue plaid top, squinting her eyes as if blinded by bright sun. The scene is slightly overexposed to mimic a hot summer day. Large orange text 炎炎夏日 appears on the screen, followed by a cut to a first-person view of hands playing a game on a smartphone. (2) In a living room setting, the woman is seen sitting on a grey fabric sofa, looking down at her phone with a frustrated and tired facial expression. A digital lightbulb icon pops up above her head accompanied by an on-screen question about gaming performance. The background is a clean, modern apartment with soft indoor lighting. (3) The scene shifts to a fast-paced product reveal where multiple packets of Airwaves gum fall onto a table in a rhythmic pattern. The woman is shown putting a piece of gum in her mouth and reacting with an exaggerated, refreshed facial expression, while the Airwaves logo and brand overlays dominate the frame. (4) Detailed shots follow, showing the woman scratching off a silver code on the back of a gum packet and entering it into a mobile game interface. She displays a range of comedic reactions, from disappointment to excitement, as rewards are revealed on her phone screen. (5) The final phase shows the woman waving at the camera while holding several packets of gum in different flavors. She stands against a background of gum packets and promotional text, concluding with high-energy gestures and brand-specific slogans appearing as graphic overlays at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice delivers a rapid-fire narration in Mandarin, characterized by a bright and enthusiastic tone. The background music is an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track with a heavy, driving drum beat and shimmering synthesizer melodies. A sharp ding sound effect is heard as a lightbulb icon appears. (2) When the gum packets fall onto the table, a series of crisp, percussive rustling and sliding sound effects are heard, synced to the visual movement. The music volume swells slightly, maintaining its high energy, and a magical whoosh sound effect accompanies the appearance of the main brand logo. (3) During the code-redeeming sequence, a metallic scratching sound effect is prominently featured, followed by several digital UI click and tap sounds as the woman interacts with her smartphone screen. The narrator voice remains constant, transitioning from an inquisitive tone to a more persuasive, advertising-style delivery. (4) A comical groan of frustration from the woman is clearly audible as she fails to win a top prize, followed by a series of success chimes and sparkle sound effects during the subsequent reward displays. The audio mix is dense, with speech, music, and sound effects overlapping throughout to create a sense of excitement and urgency. (5) The audio concludes with a final punchy beat and a brand slogan delivered with high vocal arousal. The background music ends with a clean, electronic stinger that coincides with the final logo overlay, while ambient room tone is minimal and studio-clean.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional advertisement for a collaboration between Airwaves sugar-free gum and the mobile game Arena of Valor (傳說對決). It uses a relatable gamer scenario (lack of focus) to introduce the gum as a solution for concentration, then details a lucky draw promotion featuring exclusive game skins and rewards through scratch codes on the packaging.
